'''Rover group''' was a [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] of four [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]]. The [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were patrolling a staging area when two [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Missile Boat]]s arrived with orders to eliminate all TIE Defenders in the area. Rover group moved to intercept the threat but were eliminated, along with several stationary TIE Defenders in the area. The operation was later used as a training exercise for Missile Boat pilots.
